summary: Build AI literacy, evidence, and governance for Article 4 compliance. Book practical training for your compliance and leadership teams.
lede: AI literacy training helps governance, compliance, legal, and data protection professionals turn workplace AI risks into role-based learning and documented controls. It covers building AI inventories, categorizing use cases, setting human-oversight checkpoints, designing role-based training pathways, and maintaining completion records and audit evidence to support responsible workplace AI use.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who need to design, approve, deliver, or evidence AI literacy and EU AI Act compliance across operational teams. It suits people who are responsible for AI governance, workforce training, policy controls, and documentation of responsible AI use.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with workplace AI tools, internal policy processes, or compliance workflows. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing policies, training records, AI use cases, and basic risk or control documentation. The course is pitched at an intermediate level, so you will move beyond introductory awareness and work on practical AI literacy planning, documented controls, and role-based deployment decisions.
